# 🏥 MedChain
### Blockchain-Based Secure Medical Data Management and Diagnosis System

> A decentralised, tamper-proof medical records platform built with Python and Streamlit — combining blockchain integrity, RSA cryptography, and intelligent diagnosis assistance into a single secure healthcare application.

## Overview

MedChain is a role-based medical records management system that uses a custom blockchain ledger to ensure data integrity and auditability. Medical files are stored off-chain on the local filesystem while their SHA-256 hashes, metadata, and access permissions are recorded immutably on-chain.

The system supports four distinct user roles — **Patient**, **Doctor**, **Nurse**, and **Authority** — each with fine-grained access controls enforced at both the application and cryptographic level.

---

## Features

- 🔗 **Custom blockchain ledger** — append-only chain of blocks with SHA-256 hash linking
- 🔐 **RSA-2048 encryption** — per-user keypairs for secure data access and proxy re-encryption
- 👥 **Role-based access control** — Patient, Doctor, Nurse, Authority with separate dashboards
- 📁 **Hybrid storage** — metadata on-chain, binary files (PDF/JPG/PNG) stored off-chain
- 🧠 **Intelligent diagnosis assistance** — keyword-based symptom matching and diagnosis suggestion
- 📄 **PDF prescription generation** — blockchain-verified prescriptions via FPDF
- 🚨 **Emergency break-glass access** — timed override with full audit logging
- 👩‍⚕️ **Nurse auto-assignment** — automatic nurse allocation on patient registration
- 🔍 **Authority audit panel** — full ledger visibility and emergency access monitoring
- 🛡️ **Salted SHA-256 passwords** — secure credential hashing on registration

## System Architecture

```
Patient / Doctor / Nurse / Authority
              │
              ▼
   MedChain Application (Streamlit)
   ┌──────────────────────────────┐
   │  Access Control │ Crypto     │
   │  Emergency Log  │ RSA / AES  │
   └────────┬─────────────┬───────┘
            │             │
            ▼             ▼
   Blockchain Ledger   File Storage
   (medical_ledger     (patient_uploads/)
    .json)
   • SHA-256 hash      • PDF reports
   • Patient ID        • Prescriptions
   • Doctor ID         • Images
   • Permissions       • Nurse notes
   • Timestamps
            │             │
            └──────┬──────┘
                   ▼
        Secure Retrieval & Verification
```

## Tech Stack

| Layer | Technology |
|---|---|
| Frontend | Streamlit |
| Blockchain | Custom Python implementation |
| Cryptography | `cryptography` library (RSA-2048, AES) |
| Hashing | SHA-256 via `hashlib` |
| PDF generation | FPDF2 |
| File handling | Python `os`, `base64` |
| Data storage | JSON (users + ledger), local filesystem |
| Language | Python 3.9+ |

## Installation

### 1. Clone the repository

```bash
git clone https://github.com/your-username/medchain.git
cd medchain
```

### 2. Create a virtual environment

```bash
python -m venv venv
source venv/bin/activate        # macOS / Linux
venv\Scripts\activate           # Windows
```

### 3. Install dependencies

```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt
```

### 4. Run the application

```bash
streamlit run app.py
```

The app will open at `http://localhost:8501`

Create a `requirements.txt` file with the following:

```
streamlit
fpdf2

```

## Usage

1. Open the app in your browser
2. **Register** as any role — Patient, Doctor, Nurse, or Authority
3. **Login** with your credentials
4. Interact with the dashboard based on your role:
   - Patients upload records and manage doctor access
   - Doctors view patient records and write diagnoses
   - Nurses add care notes to assigned patients
   - Authorities audit the full blockchain ledger

---

## User Roles

| Role | Permissions |
|---|---|
| **Patient** | Upload records, grant/revoke doctor access, view own records |
| **Doctor** | View permitted patient records, write diagnosis, generate prescriptions |
| **Nurse** | View assigned patient data, add nurse notes to the ledger |
| **Authority** | Read-only audit of all records, monitor emergency access events |

---

## Blockchain Design

Each block in `medical_ledger.json` contains:

```json
{
  "index": 1,
  "timestamp": "2024-06-08 10:23:45",
  "previous_hash": "abc123...",
  "current_hash": "def456...",
  "data": {
    "op": "UPLOAD_RECORD",
    "patient": "PT001",
    "doctor": "DR001",
    "file_path": "patient_uploads/PT001_report.pdf"
  }
}
```

**Supported operations:**

| Operation | Description |
|---|---|
| `UPLOAD_RECORD` | Patient uploads a medical file |
| `DIAGNOSIS` | Doctor records a diagnosis |
| `GRANT_ACCESS` | Patient grants a doctor access |
| `REVOKE_ACCESS` | Patient revokes doctor access |
| `EMERGENCY_ACCESS` | Authority triggers break-glass override |
| `ASSIGN_NURSE` | Nurse assigned to a patient |
| `RELEASE_NURSE` | Nurse released from a patient |
| `NURSE_NOTE` | Nurse adds a care note |
| `AI_ANALYSIS` | Diagnosis suggestion recorded |

---

## Security

| Mechanism | Implementation |
|---|---|
| **SHA-256 hashing** | Block integrity and password hashing |
| **RSA-2048** | Per-user keypair generation and encryption |
| **Proxy re-encryption** | Secure key delegation from patient to doctor |
| **Salted passwords** | Random salt appended before hashing |
| **Role-based access** | Enforced at login and every dashboard action |
| **Emergency audit log** | All break-glass events logged immutably |
